[Help and Legend](general-information-legend)

# MALARIA TREATMENT

Consider malaria in any febrile person who has traveled to a malaria-endemic

area in preceding months

Search "CDC malaria countries" for malaria endemic areas

[Link to open internet browser and Google search "CDC Malaria Countries"](orz-gtx-abx-url-google-cdc-malaria-countries)

Obtain malaria smear and call ID on-call in ALL cases when a malaria test is

sent

[Malaria Smear lab order](lrtz-mb-malaria-smear)

[ID on call schedule](clinical-on-call-schedule)

# Treatment

[Coartem + prior auth bundle: artemether 80 mg/lumefantrine 480 mg twice daily](orz-set-abx-malaria-treatment-and-prior-auth)

for 3 days, the first 2 doses should be administered 8 hours apart

Artesunate is appropriate in certain situations e.g. severe malaria - contact

ID on call
